question: How can I track my order?
answer: Go to My Orders in your account and click Track Order. You will also get a tracking link by email once your order is shipped.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: You can return any unused item within 7 days of delivery. The item must be in its original packaging.

question: How do I cancel my order?
answer: You can cancel an order before it is shipped. Go to My Orders, select the order and click Cancel Order.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Delivery takes 2-3 working days inside Dhaka and 4-6 working days for other cities.

question: What is the delivery charge?
answer: Delivery charge is 60 BDT inside Dhaka and 120 BDT outside Dhaka. Orders above 3000 BDT get free delivery.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept bKash, Nagad, credit/debit cards and Cash on Delivery.

question: Is Cash on Delivery available?
answer: Yes, Cash on Delivery is available for all orders up to 20,000 BDT.

question: How do I get a refund?
answer: Once we receive your returned item, the refund is processed within 5-7 working days to your original payment method.

question: How can I reset my password?
answer: Click Forgot Password on the login page, enter your email and follow the link we send you.

question: How do I create an account?
answer: Click Sign Up at the top right of the page, enter your name, email and password, then verify your email.

question: How can I contact customer support?
answer: You can email us at support@Riya.com or call 09600-000000 every day from 9 AM to 9 PM.

question: Do you offer international shipping?
answer: Currently we deliver only inside Bangladesh. International shipping will be available soon.

question: Can I change my delivery address?
answer: Yes, you can change the address before the order is shipped. Contact customer support with your order number.

question: My product is damaged or wrong. What should I do?
answer: We are sorry about that! Contact support within 48 hours of delivery with a photo of the product and we will replace it for free.

question: Do you provide warranty on products?
answer: Electronics come with a 1 year warranty. The warranty details are written on each product page.

question: How can I use a discount coupon?
answer: Enter your coupon code in the Apply Coupon box on the checkout page before paying.
